item.text:
Implemented the Rust migration as a complete Cargo project in `/output`, with the root entrypoint at [test17.rs](/output/test17.rs), shared library exports in [src/lib.rs](/output/src/lib.rs), and the reimplemented codec/parser in [src/url_codec.rs](/output/src/url_codec.rs) and [src/url.rs](/output/src/url.rs). It uses only `std`, parses CLI args with `std::env::args()`, and preserves the C++ behavior including lowercase percent-encoding, `+` to space decoding, and raw-byte stdout for cases like `%ff`.

Build and verification both passed. I ran `cargo build --release`, `cargo test`, and `rustc --edition=2021 /output/test17.rs -o /output/test17`. I also compared `/output/test17` byte-for-byte against `/workspace/dataset/test17_executable` on representative inputs including `hello`, `Hello World`, `a+b`, `%2F`, `%ff`, `你好`, `🙂`, and `/?:@&=+$,#`, and the outputs matched.
